scope: Production frontend run HTTP transport, account memory replay, runtime discovery, history/event integration and presentation
outcome: Focused frontend implementation verification passed on the pinned source
overlap_note: The 35 presentation/contract follow-up cases overlap the 222-case focused suite and verify the final event-backfill copy change. The 10 actual-wire cases are additional.

strict_typecheck.includes: All seven owned app source files and all five owned test files

actual_python_wire.execution: Standalone TypeScript client decodes saved root-captured Python HTTP stack envelopes; frontend CI needs no Python or database.

implemented_boundaries: Fixed same-origin POST paths; no-store, omitted cookies, rejected redirects, optional in-memory bearer injection.
Strict bounded JSON/UTF-8/duplicate-key/depth/unsafe-number validation; authoritative HTTP error status despite malformed error body; aborted or late responses cannot commit.
Submit transmits original C17 IDs and expected hashes only; server owns frozen context resolution. Mutation retry preserves original immutable body and key.
Exact runtime research_runs discovery controls production availability; no network, URL, browser storage or legacy fixture fallback. Explicit development fixture injection remains separate.
Conversation-scoped history discovery and consecutive event backfill retain a separate high-water cursor. Snapshot merges preserve the complete immutable original context and verified events.
Permission/account changes clear protected in-memory state. Production history is displayed only after current authorized discovery; failures/timeouts hide it.
Disabled dispatch preserves authorized history and cancellation. Awaiting approval has no fabricated approval action. Ordinary completion with result:null states that an answer is not available.
qualifications: No assembled browser verification is claimed; C26 remains the formal reload/reconnect/all-actions browser gate.
No external provider call, real-data acquisition, cloud provisioning or deployment was performed by this frontend task.
Root owns broad regressions, PostgreSQL acceptance, hosted CI, source checkpoint and final component delivery.
Initial test-only TypeScript narrowing/readonly failures are retained in frontend-typecheck-initial.txt and corrected before final checks.
Original C18/C19 receipts and the explicit development fixture source were not modified.
